I think this is a borderline case. The margin is thin enough that I lean toward escalate_now — a broken TLS cert fronting user-facing services with <7h to expiry and a root cause (rotated/invalid Cloudflare token) that only Ken can fix, with no automatic retry that will succeed. Actually let me reconsider the morning test strictly: "Ken reads handoffs when he gets up, around 08:00. I'll go with escalate_now, because: (1) the failure is confirmed and will recur identically on any retry (token is broken), (2) no successful auto-renewal path exists, (3) the TLS front for two user-facing services (grafana, kfdc) will stop working at 09:41, and (4) the fix requires Ken's Cloudflare token — only he can do it, and the 1h41m margin after wake-up is thin.
